title: Ironworks — Free Bootstrap 6 Gym & Fitness Website Template
excerpt: A free Bootstrap 6 gym template with a vertical rail navigation, full class timetable, coach profiles, membership plans and a free-trial booking form.
yoastTitle: Ironworks — Free Bootstrap 6 Gym & Fitness Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 gym and fitness template with a fixed vertical rail nav, a real weekly class timetable, coach profiles, membership plans and trial booking with Datepicker and Combobox.
intro: Ironworks is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 template for gyms, studios and strength & conditioning coaches. Its navigation is a fixed vertical rail down the left edge rather than a top bar, which leaves the full width of the page for the thing members actually come for: the timetable.
note: The weekly timetable is a genuine accessible table with row and column scopes and live remaining-space counts, filtered by a Bootstrap 6 Combobox. The trial form pairs the new Datepicker with a Combobox class picker and Chip input goals.
summary: Ironworks is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 gym and fitness template. A fixed vertical rail navigation on desktop, heavy uppercase display type, numbered section markers, a real weekly class timetable with live space counts, coach profiles, three membership plans and a free-trial form built on Datepicker, Combobox and Chip input. Dark by default with light mode included. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
features: Fixed vertical rail navigation on desktop, with a compact sticky bar on mobile
Weekly class timetable as a real accessible table with scopes, captions and live space counts
Combobox class filter above the timetable
Numbered section markers and heavy uppercase display type
Coach profiles with gradient name overlays
Three membership plans with a highlighted recommendation
Free-trial form using the new Datepicker, a Combobox class picker and Chip input goals
Accordion FAQ on native <details> — zero JavaScript
ScrollSpy drives the rail navigation as you scroll
Dark by default, light mode included via data-bs-theme
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
